email.subject: Stride Pros site: a couple quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Ivy,

I checked Stride Pros Fitness's site. Two things likely cost you members: it doesn't display properly on phones, and there's no tap-to-call button, so mobile visitors can't reach you with one tap and probably just call another gym. The footer also still shows an old date, which can make people second-guess if you're active.

I fix issues like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what's going on and what I'd change. Open to a quick call this week?

Alex
Northlight Web
